tasks.label: check-shell-task
tasks.command: pwd

tasks.label: generate-handover-pdfs
tasks.command: node tools/scripts/generate-handover-pdfs.mjs

tasks.label: check-playwright-cli
tasks.command: pnpm exec playwright --version

tasks.label: generate-handover-pdfs-pnpm
tasks.command: pnpm exec node tools/scripts/generate-handover-pdfs.mjs

tasks.label: generate-handover-pdfs-app-scope
tasks.command: cd apps/save-philly-festivals && node scripts/generate-handover-pdfs.mjs

tasks.label: convert-user-guide-pdf
tasks.command: pnpm dlx md-to-pdf docs/Client-UserGuide.md

tasks.label: convert-user-guide-pdf-noninteractive
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-UserGuide.md

tasks.label: convert-handoff-pdf-noninteractive
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off.md

tasks.label: convert-styled-user-guide-pdf
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.html --dest docs/Client-UserGuide.pdf

tasks.label: md-to-pdf-help
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf --help

tasks.label: convert-styled-guides-to-pdf
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.html && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.html && mv -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.pdf docs/Client-UserGuide.pdf && mv -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off.pdf

tasks.label: export-handover-guides-pdf
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Technical-Developer-Guide.md && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/N8N-Owner-Guide.md && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-UserGuide.md

tasks.label: rebuild-client-handoff-pdfs
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off.md && cp docs/Client-Hand-Off.pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off-Full.pdf && if [ -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.html ]; then CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.html && mv -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off-Summary.pdf; fi

tasks.label: regenerate-branded-handover-pdfs
tasks.command: CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off.md --stylesheet docs/handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css && cp docs/Client-Hand-Off.pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off-Full.pdf && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Client-UserGuide.md --stylesheet docs/handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/Technical-Developer-Guide.md --stylesheet docs/handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/N8N-Owner-Guide.md --stylesheet docs/handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.html && mv -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.pdf docs/Client-Hand-Off-Summary.pdf && CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf docs/handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.html && mv -f docs/handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.pdf docs/Client-UserGuide-Summary.pdf

tasks.label: clean-and-rebuild-styled-pdfs
tasks.command:
set -e
cd docs
rm -f Client-Hand-Off-Full.pdf
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf Client-Hand-Off.md --stylesheet handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf Client-UserGuide.md --stylesheet handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf Technical-Developer-Guide.md --stylesheet handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf N8N-Owner-Guide.md --stylesheet handover-pdf-source/client-brand-pdf.css
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.html
mv -f handover-pdf-source/client-handoff-guide.pdf Client-Hand-Off-Summary.pdf
CI=1 pnpm dlx --allow-build=puppeteer md-to-pdf handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.html
mv -f handover-pdf-source/client-user-guide.pdf Client-UserGuide-Summary.pdf
ls -lh *.pdf

tasks.label: git-branch-audit-1
tasks.command: git status -sb && echo '---' && git branch -vv && echo '---' && git remote -v

tasks.label: git-branch-audit-2
tasks.command: git fetch --all --prune && echo '--- AHEAD COMMITS ---' && git log --oneline origin/main..main && echo '--- LOCAL BRANCHES NOT MERGED INTO MAIN ---' && git branch --no-merged main && echo '--- REMOTE BRANCHES NOT MERGED INTO ORIGIN/MAIN ---' && git branch -r --no-merged origin/main

tasks.label: git-branch-audit-3
tasks.command: echo 'main vs origin/develop:' && git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/develop && echo '--- COMMITS ONLY IN origin/develop (top 20) ---' && git log --oneline main..origin/develop | head -20 && echo '--- COMMITS ONLY IN main (top 20) ---' && git log --oneline origin/develop..main | head -20

tasks.label: push-main
tasks.command: git push origin main

tasks.label: post-push-verification
tasks.command: git status -sb && echo '---' && git branch -vv && echo '--- REMOTE BRANCHES NOT MERGED INTO origin/main ---' && git branch -r --no-merged origin/main

tasks.label: develop-authors-audit
tasks.command: echo 'COMMITS ONLY IN origin/develop:' && git log --pretty=format:'%h | %an <%ae> | %ad | %s' --date=short origin/main..origin/develop

tasks.label: remove-develop-branch
tasks.command:
set -e
git push origin --delete develop
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/dev; then git branch -D dev; fi
git fetch --all --prune
echo '--- Remaining remote branches not merged into origin/main ---'
git branch -r --no-merged origin/main || true

tasks.label: verify-branch-cleanup
tasks.command: git branch -vv && echo '---' && git branch -r && echo '--- main relation ---' && git status -sb

tasks.label: create-dev-worktree
tasks.command:
set -e
git fetch origin --prune
mkdir -p .worktrees
git worktree add .worktrees/dev -B dev origin/dev
git -C .worktrees/dev status -sb

tasks.label: inspect-dev-tree-layout
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && pwd && ls -la && echo '--- top dirs ---' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -40

tasks.label: find-problem-files-dev
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && rg -n "min-h-\[90px\]|min-h-\[70px\]|min-h-\[120px\]|min-h-\[60px\]|min-w-\[768px\]|min-w-\[960px\]|-left-\[21px\]|-left-\[31px\]|break-words" src

tasks.label: find-problem-files-dev-grep
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && grep -R -nE "min-h-\[90px\]|min-h-\[70px\]|min-h-\[120px\]|min-h-\[60px\]|min-w-\[768px\]|min-w-\[960px\]|-left-\[21px\]|-left-\[31px\]|break-words" src || true

tasks.label: recreate-dev-from-main
tasks.command:
set -e
if [ -d .worktrees/dev ]; then git worktree remove .worktrees/dev --force; fi
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/dev; then git branch -D dev; fi
git fetch origin --prune
git worktree add .worktrees/dev -b dev origin/main
git -C .worktrees/dev status -sb

tasks.label: locate-15-issues-in-dev-from-main
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && grep -R -nE "min-h-\[90px\]|min-h-\[70px\]|min-h-\[120px\]|min-h-\[60px\]|min-w-\[768px\]|min-w-\[960px\]|-left-\[21px\]|-left-\[31px\]|break-words" apps/save-philly-festivals/src || true

tasks.label: test-dev-fixes
tasks.command:
set -e
cd .worktrees/dev
pnpm exec nx run save-philly-festivals:lint --outputStyle=static
pnpm exec nx run save-philly-festivals:test --outputStyle=static

tasks.label: inspect-dev-worktree-root
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && pwd && ls -1 | head -40 && echo '---' && ls -1 apps | head -20

tasks.label: debug-prisma-config-failure
tasks.command: cd .worktrees/dev && ls apps/save-philly-festivals/prisma.config.ts && pnpm exec prisma generate --config apps/save-philly-festivals/prisma.config.ts

tasks.label: commit-dev-fix
tasks.command:
set -e
cd .worktrees/dev
git add apps/save-philly-festivals/src/features/producer-submission/ProducerSubmissionEditor.jsx
git commit -m "style: replace deprecated break-words utility in producer summary"
git log --oneline -1

tasks.label: merge-dev-into-main-and-push
tasks.command:
set -e
if [ -d .worktrees/main-merge ]; then git worktree remove .worktrees/main-merge --force; fi
git worktree add .worktrees/main-merge -b main-merge origin/main
cd .worktrees/main-merge
git merge --no-ff dev -m "Merge branch 'dev'"
git push origin HEAD:main
git log --oneline -2

tasks.label: final-git-audit
tasks.command: git fetch origin --prune && echo '--- origin/main latest ---' && git log --oneline -3 origin/main && echo '--- local integration branches ---' && git branch --list 'dev' 'main-merge' && echo '--- remote branches not merged into origin/main ---' && git branch -r --no-merged origin/main
